topic.title: pilkwang/rsna-knee-weights: what data and training code are behind these weights?

comments.content:
Thanks for asking. The 20 checkpoints in pilkwang/rsna-knee-weights are one DINOv2-small slice-window model (four seeds × five folds), trained in August on the competition's training MRI. The labels are a separate component: an LLM extracted them from the competition's own radiology reports, and that label table and the labelling script are public in pilkwang/rsna-knee-llm-labels. According to the original run records, no external medical data (OAI, MRNet, fastMRI, SKM-TEA or similar) was used. The only outside component of the image model is the general DINOv2-small pretrained backbone from Hugging Face.

The exact training source of that August run predates our version control and is not preserved byte for byte, so I won't post a code pack that claims to reproduce it exactly. I've added a README to the dataset with the training and input settings from the run records. manifest.json records each member's architecture and input configuration and a fingerprint for checking a reload; a compatible head and reader implementation is still needed to load them.

Ref. RSNA Knee baseline v1
